papers.title: Corrosion-Wear Mechanism of (AlTiV)100−xCrx Lightweight High-Entropy Alloy in the 3.5 wt.% NaCl Solution
papers.abstract: (AlTiV)100−xCrx high-entropy alloys (HEAs) is expected to solve the problem of poor corrosion-wear resistance of lightweight alloys. To elucidate its corrosion-wear mechanism, three (AlTiV)100−xCrx alloys were prepared by vacuum arc melting method by repeating the melting five times at 240 A current.and their microstructures, mechanics, corrosion, wear, and corrosion-wear behaviors were investigated. The results indicate that (AlTiV)100−xCrx is a single-phase with BCC structure and the VEC of Cr5, Cr10 and Cr15 were 4.0, 4.1 and 4.2 respectively. Their hardness increase and toughness and corrosion resistance decrease with the increase of Cr content (Cr5:537.5 HV0.2/6.7%/1.86 × 10−8 A/cm2; Cr10:572.3 HV0.2/5.6%/2.09 × 108 A/cm2; Cr15:617.6 HV0.2/3.8%/2.51 × 10−8 A/cm2). The wear volume and the corrosion-wear volume of AlTiVCr alloys are mainly caused by the abrasive wear. However, the fatigue wear of AlTiVCr alloys could be exacerbated by a decrease in material’s toughness, corrosion resistance, and an increase in solution corrosivity. Therefore, Cr10 presents the optimal wear resistance in the deionized water, while the optimal corrosion-wear resistance in the 3.5 wt.% NaCl solution is presented by Cr5. Compared to TC4, the wear and corrosion-wear resistance were improved by 56.4% and 65.5%, respectively.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究的是(AlTiV)100−xCrx高熵合金，并非Ti-6Al-4V，与研究方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: The paper investigates corrosion-wear of high-entropy alloys, not Ti-6Al-4V, and does not address additive manufacturing of Ti-6Al-4V.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究轻质高熵合金的腐蚀-磨损机理。
summary_zh.method: 通过真空电弧熔炼制备三种不同Cr含量的(AlTiV)100−xCrx合金，表征其微观结构、力学、腐蚀和磨损性能。
summary_zh.result: Cr10在去离子水中耐磨性最佳，Cr5在NaCl溶液中耐腐蚀磨损性最优，均优于TC4。
summary_zh.validation: 通过微观结构表征、硬度、腐蚀电流密度和磨损体积等实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To elucidate the corrosion-wear mechanism of (AlTiV)100−xCrx high-entropy alloys as a potential solution for poor corrosion-wear resistance of lightweight alloys.
summary_en.method: Three (AlTiV)100−xCrx alloys with varying Cr content were prepared by vacuum arc melting, and their microstructure, mechanical properties, corrosion, wear, and corrosion-wear behaviors were investigated.
summary_en.result: Cr10 exhibited optimal wear resistance in deionized water, while Cr5 showed the best corrosion-wear resistance in 3.5 wt.% NaCl solution, both outperforming TC4.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation through hardness, polarization curves, wear volume measurements, and comparison with TC4.

papers.title: Equiaxed fine grain and performance control of laser directed energy deposition Ti-6Al-4V components using synchronous-hammer-forging method

corresponding_authors.name: Fangyong Niu
corresponding_authors.affiliation: State Key Laboratory of High-performance Precision Manufacturing, Dalian University of Technology, Dalian 116024, People's Republic of China

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文通过同步锤锻方法改善了激光定向能量沉积Ti-6Al-4V的微观结构和力学性能，直接相关于增材制造Ti-6Al-4V的基础力学与疲劳性能研究。
llm.why_not_core: The paper focuses on grain refinement and mechanical properties via in-situ hammer forging, but does not specifically address fatigue life or S-N curves, which are core to the fatigue direction.

summary_zh.motivation: 为了解决激光定向能量沉积Ti-6Al-4V构件粗大柱状晶和性能不足的问题。
summary_zh.method: 在激光沉积过程中引入同步锤锻，实现动态再结晶和晶粒细化。
summary_zh.result: 获得了等轴细晶组织，拉伸强度和塑性同时提升。
summary_zh.validation: 通过显微组织观察和室温拉伸试验验证了该方法的效果。

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the coarse columnar grains and inadequate mechanical properties of laser directed energy deposited Ti-6Al-4V components.
summary_en.method: Synchronous hammer forging was applied during the deposition process to induce dynamic recrystallization and grain refinement.
summary_en.result: Equiaxed fine grains were obtained, resulting in simultaneous improvement of tensile strength and ductility.
summary_en.validation: Microstructural characterization and room-temperature tensile testing confirmed the effectiveness of the method.
